content.topic: Skill discovery is distinct from execution authorization
content.problem: Tool discovery can be confused with permission to execute
content.hook: Finding a skill is not the same as authorizing it.
content.thesis: Separate discovery, capability resolution, and execution approval.
content.body: A skill router can tell you what exists without granting the right to run it. Keep discovery and execution authorization separate, then verify the actual gate.
content.visual: Human-created diagram of three distinct decisions; do not present it as a screenshot.
content.alt: Three boxes labeled discovery, resolution and execution approval.
content.discussion_question: Where do your own agent workflows enforce this boundary?
content.risk: Verify the PR and current implementation before using; source analysis is not a firsthand test.
